original_value: Several researchers have revealed the huge potentials of rescue robots in disaster zones. In addition to searching for victims, these intelligent machines are also effective in obtaining useful information from the zones. These functions help to optimize the search and rescue missions. However, the fact that rescue robots have to operate in risky and dangerous environments necessitates the need for such machines to have an efficient motion control system, which can help them to operate autonomously or with minimal human control. This paper reviews the use of reliable controllers in enhancing the sensing capabilities of rescue robots. Huge potential of sensorless sensing method in the rescue robots are highlighted. It is shown that the use of sensorless sensing method enables developer to create simple and cheaper robots for various complex situations. Thus, it is imperative to conduct further studies on how to optimize the operations of robots that lack sensors.

result.paraphrase: Researchers have highlighted the substantial potential of rescue robots in disaster areas. Beyond locating victims, these intelligent machines can also collect valuable information from affected zones, helping improve search-and-rescue operations. Because they must work in hazardous and dangerous environments, rescue robots need an efficient motion control system so they can function autonomously or with minimal human intervention. This paper examines the role of dependable controllers in improving the sensing abilities of rescue robots. It emphasizes the great promise of sensorless sensing methods for rescue robots. The study shows that sensorless sensing allows developers to build simpler, less expensive robots for a range of complex situations. Therefore, further research is needed to optimize the operation of robots without sensors.
